findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target ".ch" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.24s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: <circle> is hidden with stroke-dasharray 1 and stroke-dashoffset 1 on pathLength 1, but its round cap can still paint a dot at the end of the path (Chrome rounds the zero-length dash differently per curve).
findings.fixHint: Make the gap longer than the path (stroke-dasharray "1 1.2" with stroke-dashoffset 1.1), or keep the element visibility:hidden until its draw tween starts.

"RAM · SSD · CHIPS · 2026" (4 words) is on screen 0.13 s (±0.01 s), under its 1.27 s floor: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word (1.70 s here) before it leaves or changes; see references/motion.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 5 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Price updated" at 22 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
"more than doubled." (3 words) is on screen 1.00 s (±0.01 s), under its 1.05 s floor: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word (1.40 s here) before it leaves or changes; see references/motion.md.
